# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems. Report them privately, either:

- through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/joshuawowk/icue-widget-clickup/security/advisories/new) for this repository, or
- by email to [josh@jwowk.net](mailto:josh@jwowk.net).

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the affected version. You can expect an acknowledgement within a few days.

This project handles a personal ClickUp API token that you enter in iCUE (widget) or on your device (Android app). Reports about token storage or exposure are in scope.
